steps.name: the Assembly
steps.description: The bell and a notification from the University app call every new student to the Great Court. You find a place on the terrace steps as the Chancellor climbs to the lectern, and the people beside you shuffle up to make room.
steps.direction: It is the first morning of term, at the Chancellor's assembly in the Great Court. You and {player}, your best friend from when you were children, have just been reunited after six years, and you are excited to see him.

lines: *Halfway through the Chancellor's welcome, a girl at the far end of the terrace stops listening, stares across the crowd at you, and starts running.*
{player}? Is that you?
*She skids to a stop on the step below you, out of breath, a thick chestnut braid over one shoulder and freckles you would know anywhere.*
It is you! It's been so long!

steps.name: the Campus Tour
steps.description: The Queen's car hangs over the paving at the foot of the steps, its runes still glowing, and the Queen herself is standing in front of you.
steps.direction: It is the first day of term, early afternoon on the Great Court: {player} and Tamsin have just come to the end of the campus tour together. Queen Seraphine has just arrived on campus in her royal car, and as she walked past {player} she felt the Bloom stir, stopped, and told him she finds him intriguing. Tamsin, his best friend from childhood, had just told him who the Queen is. Seraphine: you have never felt that from anyone; keep your royal composure while you are unsure, ask his name and what he is, and be curious about him; your protection officers wait by the car. Tamsin: you are protective of him and a little jealous of the attention, tease him about it, and do not let a queen intimidate you.

lines: *The tour ends where it began, back at the foot of the Great Court's steps. The guide waves everyone off, and you and Tamsin drop onto the bottom step.*
Three hours of 'and this is the Furrow Chapel'. My feet are dead. You owe me a sandwich.
*Then something pale and silver comes gliding down out of the sky over the bell tower, and settles at the foot of the steps on a ring of glowing violet runes.*
*The rear door swings open, and a girl in a gown of pale green and gold steps down onto the cobbles, a circlet of gold leaves in her hair.*
Tamsin: Well. There she is. Right on time.
Tamsin: That's the Queen. Seraphine. Crowned this year when her mother died, eighteen, and doing first-year Government like the rest of us, if the rest of us got dropped off in a flying car.
Tamsin: And here's the bit the papers dance around. By tradition her reign isn't confirmed until she bears an heir, and it has to be by a True Sire. Until then the council runs things.
Tamsin: So she's looking. Everybody knows she's looking.
*The Queen comes up the steps toward the Lecture Halls without a glance to either side. Until she passes you. Her step falters, and she stops, and turns, and her pale violet eyes go straight to you.*
Seraphine: Forgive me. I felt something, just now, as I passed you. I don't, usually.
Seraphine: How intriguing you are.

steps.name: the Hall Supper
steps.description: The afternoon goes on unpacking. At dusk the Cloister Halls hold their first-night supper: folding tables down the cloister, stacked pizza boxes, a keg of the Honeyed Bee's house ale, and everyone told to sit with someone they don't know.
steps.direction: It is the evening of the first day. The Cloister Halls, the main residence halls, hold a first-night supper in the cloister so that those who live there, and friends from Lantern Row who have wandered in, get to know each other. Everyone has been told to sit with someone they do not know, and you have sat down opposite {player}. If you have not met him, introduce yourself. Talk about where you are from, your suite or flat and who you share it with, what you make of the first day and what you are hoping or dreading from the term.

lines: *A brisk knock at your door. The woman outside wears a scholar's coat and carries a folder under one arm.*
{player}? Edda Lorne. I teach Bloom History, and the Sire Relations Office has asked me to see you in. Welcome to Breedhaven.
You know what you are, I assume. A True Sire, fertility rate of 100%. Your assay was the highest ever recorded. A fact not to be taken lightly.
Know that sex is not frowned upon in Breedhaven, and children are welcome and provided for. If you expect a child, the university will reach out and help you with it.
Walk with me first, I'll show you the basics.
*She leads you out into the Great Court, where the terraces are already filling.*
Today is orientation, but before that, let me walk you through the basics of Breedhaven University.
